items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There had been some old ragtime books that Fess and all of them talk about...

ctx.x: That's what I wanted to make clear on that. That's mostly military marches.
There had been some old ragtime books that Fess and all of them talk about calling the Redback Oh no, I wasn't referring to that.
I was talking about the school book, I mean the musical school, I mean the second grade of music you run into red books.
